readings: Treat a film as long if its length is strictly greater than 112 minutes (film.length > 112). Take all of those films as one group. Return a single row with two figures in this order: (1) the average length, and (2) the average of each film's replacement_cost divided by its rental_rate, computed per film and then averaged. Ignore missing values in each average, and give NULL if none remain. Don't round.

Treat a film as long if its length is 112 minutes or more (film.length >= 112). Take all of those films as one group. Return a single row with two figures in this order: (1) the average length, and (2) the average of each film's replacement_cost divided by its rental_rate, computed per film and then averaged. Ignore missing values in each average, and give NULL if none remain. Don't round.
queries:
SELECT AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) FROM film WHERE length > 112;
SELECT AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) FROM film WHERE length >= 112;
